company.name: Compass
company.shortDescription: Compass is a real estate technology company that provides an online platform for buying, renting, and selling real estate assets.
company.description:
Compass is a real estate technology company that provides an online platform for buying, renting, and selling real estate assets.

Its end-to-end platform supports the entire buying and selling workflow by pairing the industry’s top talent with technology to make the search and sell experience intelligent and seamless. Compass operates in 22+ regions across the United States including New York, Los Angeles, and Orange County, Chicago, San Francisco, Boston, Washington D.C., South Florida, The Hamptons, Santa Barbara and Montecito, San Diego, Seattle and Eastside, Philadelphia, Connecticut, Westchester, Aspen, Boulder, Denver, Atlanta, Austin, and Central Texas, Dallas-Fort Worth, Houston, Nashville, and Lake Tahoe.

The firm was founded in 2012 by Ugo Di Girolamo, Ori Allon, and Robert Reffkin in New York, New York.

insights.title: Funding is concentrated in the latest major round
insights.statement: The latest disclosed Post IPO Debt round raised $850,000,000, or 32.53% of reported total funding.
insights.implication: This round accounts for most reported historical financing, making it important when assessing funding-source concentration and fundraising cadence.
caveats: Crunchbase reports 12 rounds but provides 10 detailed rows.

insights.title: Valuation increased across disclosed rounds
insights.statement: Known post-money valuation rose from $360,000,000 to $6,400,000,000, a 17.78x increase.
insights.implication: The disclosed financing history indicates a material valuation step-up between the earliest and latest rounds with known valuations.
caveats: Only rounds with a disclosed post-money valuation are compared.

insights.title: Sharp recent attention and growth momentum
insights.statement: Crunchbase scores growth at 92 (+1 over 90 days) and market heat at 69 (-14).
insights.implication: The company has recently become much more visible, but the scores should be treated as attention/activity indicators rather than revenue or clinical-performance metrics.
caveats: Crunchbase does not expose the complete weighting behind these proprietary scores.

insights.title: Strategic repositioning and listing coverage shape the current narrative
insights.statement: Compass has a recent strategic-positioning change; 1 recent unique news titles explicitly contain the English terms IPO or listing.
insights.implication: Their timing coincides with increased visibility in the loaded news and Crunchbase momentum signals, but the data does not establish causation.
caveats: The causal link to Crunchbase momentum is an inference from timing, not a disclosed company metric.
